question: Does the ROIC.ai Free plan reach every endpoint for every public company, or only AAPL and a subset, as the per-endpoint pages state?
why: The authentication page and the changelog of 4 June 2026 say every plan, Free included, has full access and differs only by 5 requests per minute and 2 years of history. The pricing comparison table lists batch stock prices and the earnings calendar as not included on Free, most endpoint pages say Free tier: AAPL available on free tier, and the ticker list page says Free tier: Premium only. Only a free key can settle which holds. behind a sign-up
